not_claimed_deliberately: A HARDWARE frame rate is NOT claimed, and neither is a target FPS. The node-count curve IS measured now (leg B8_W10_BROWSER_PERF, over 50/200/500/1000 objects of real persisted work, in real Chrome, on the real cross-origin topology), but headless Chrome on this host rasterizes through ANGLE/SwiftShader -- verified by launching it four ways, all four CPU -- so the frame times are a software rasterizer's floor. The gate's evidence records the renderer string and a derived renderer_class so the number cannot be quoted without that context. The v1.2 verdict PENDING is carried forward unchanged.

Single-view rendering beyond DOMAIN_LIST_LIMIT (1000) objects is NOT claimed. The product SAYS the view is partial (Wave 9.3) but does not page; the honest limit is measured and disclosed rather than hidden.

Parent-exit survival of the product runtime is NOT claimed by this gate. The W8 restart transcript is evidence about the CONTROLLER, not proof that the service outlives its launcher; only the host Task Scheduler registration (pending, above) can establish that, and the claim stays open until it is measured on a host.

DPAPI-at-rest for the control token is NOT claimed: the token stays an environment variable, which is what W8 shipped and what the health contract exposes. A stronger claim would need a key store the sandbox cannot provide.

Fast domain writes are NOT claimed. Measured, disclosed and NOT fixed: DomainStore._conn() re-issues three PRAGMAs per connection and the store opens a fresh connection per operation -- twice per mission creation -- so every call is exposed to the host's file-syncing latency. Measured 194 ms for create_mission on a quiet host and up to ~1.4 s under load, with the per-commit cost shown NOT to track data size and the HTTP layer shown NOT to contribute. Part of that cost is unexplained and is recorded as unexplained. See tools/v1_3_domain_io_profile.py and docs/v1_3/WAVE_10_REAL_BROWSER_PERFORMANCE.md section 8.
pending_host_activation: Unregister the two stray Scheduled Tasks created during the measured incident recorded in docs/v1_3/WAVE_8_DURABLE_RUNTIME.md section 6: JCC-v1.3-API and JCC-v1.3-PROBE (schtasks.exe is blacklisted in the agent sandbox and Windows' own unregister path goes through the same blind CIM provider, so this cannot be done from here).

Run scripts\jcc-v1.3-register-tasks.ps1 -Apply from an ELEVATED PowerShell on the host to create the durable JCC-v1.3-API / JCC-v1.3-VisualUI tasks, then `scripts\jcc-v1.3.ps1 -Action mark` to adopt them.

Authenticate the WorkBuddy CLI for the account the JCC API runs under, so a launcher-spawned non-interactive process can obtain credentials. Until it is done the launch read-back classifies the run as AUTH_REQUIRED, the mission is NOT walked to RUNNING by design, and the capability reads HOST_ACTIVATION_PENDING (see docs/v1_3/WAVE_9_2_MISSION_LAUNCH_CONTROL.md section 8).
